attempts.prompt: Instrumental background music for an antique hand-painted nautical world map. A historical wooden merchant sailing ship travelling across a calm open ocean. Peaceful, spacious, warm, a restrained sense of exploration and anticipation. Gentle orchestral strings, soft woodwinds and light plucked strings, slow steady pulse, understated melody, stable dynamics. No vocals, no speech, no ocean or ship sound effects, no dramatic climax. A coherent 30-second game background cue.

Consistent natural rhythm and loudness, seamless gameplay movement loop, no intro or outro. No engine, voices, music, wind, birds or large waves.
